_doc: Champs d'une scène : id, debut (premiers mots du passage), mouvement, et pour l'image : action, expression, variante (costume alternatif de la bible), costume_de / monument_de (autre civilisation), objet, decor (éléments imposés, complétés par la rotation de la bible), habitants, lumiere, position_monument, premier_plan. icon_dark : objet. outro : symboles. Les éléments de décor non imposés sont piochés en rotation dans assets/civilisations.json.

scenes.expression: wide open in surprise with raised eyebrows
scenes.action: turning around in shock as the huge shadow of a bearded Sumerian countryball falls over it
scenes.lumiere: warm sunset glow with dramatic clouds and drifting sand

scenes.debut: Il y a plus de cinq mille ans
scenes.action: standing on a grassy hill at sunrise, the Tigris and the Euphrates winding behind it
scenes.position_monument: small in the far distance between the two rivers
decor: the winding Tigris and Euphrates rivers
scenes.lumiere: misty dawn light with the rising sun, soft volumetric rays and a richly painted cloudy sky

scenes.action: standing on a rocky hill and pointing at the fertile land between two rivers
decor: the winding Tigris and Euphrates rivers

scenes.action: standing on a dry cracked arid plain on the left, while on the right other countryballs dig irrigation canals
scenes.habitants: countryball farmers in kaunakes skirts digging canals and carrying baskets
scenes.position_monument: small on the far RIGHT horizon

scenes.action: standing on a hill overlooking the city of Uruk
scenes.position_monument: rising at the center of the city behind the character
decor: a monumental city gate decorated with glazed blue bricks
narrow streets full of countryball inhabitants
scenes.habitants: crowds of small countryball inhabitants in kaunakes skirts walking, trading and carrying jars

scenes.objet: a sharpened reed stylus pressing wedge-shaped decorative cuneiform marks into a wet clay tablet
scenes.action: sitting cross-legged in a scribe workshop lit by oil lamps
scenes.position_monument: visible through a wide open doorway behind the character
scenes.lumiere: flickering oil-lamp light with a warm glow, dust floating in the light beams

scenes.debut: Ils sont aussi parmi les premiers
scenes.objet: an ancient solid wooden Sumerian chariot wheel made of three carved planks held together by wooden crossbars, with copper nails and a central axle hole

scenes.debut: et ils comptent en base soixante
scenes.objet: a round clock dial made of golden baked clay, marked with 60 carved graduations, surrounded by a thin engraved graduated circle, no digits

scenes.action: standing at the foot of the great ziggurat
scenes.position_monument: towering on the LEFT side of the panorama
decor: a sacred procession on the monumental staircase
scenes.habitants: countryball priests in white robes climbing the steps
scenes.lumiere: warm sunset glow with dramatic orange and red clouds and drifting incense smoke

scenes.action: playing the hero Gilgamesh, bravely facing a huge roaring cartoon lion in a dense cedar forest
scenes.position_monument: far in the distance beyond the cedar forest
decor: rays of light through the branches
scenes.habitants: small countryball warriors watching from behind the trees
scenes.lumiere: volumetric light rays through the forest canopy with floating dust

scenes.action: playing King Sargon of Akkad, leading a charging army in front of the walls of a burning Sumerian city
scenes.position_monument: behind the burning city walls, partly hidden by smoke
scenes.habitants: an army of Akkadian countryball soldiers with bronze helmets, spears and shields
scenes.lumiere: dramatic red sky with fire glow, embers and smoke

symboles: a golden clay clock dial with 60 graduations
scenes.lumiere: golden hour glow with volumetric rays and sparkling particles
